name: PMICE Koumra digital-infrastructure sites (fiber, transmission pylons, multimedia center, SOTEL installations)
developer: PMICE (Projet de Modernisation des Infrastructures de Communications Electroniques) - Ministry of Telecommunications; Huawei delivery partner
notes: Minister Boukar Michel inspected PMICE digital infrastructure in Mandoul (Koumra) in early May 2025: fiber-optic sites, transmission pylons, a multimedia center and SOTEL installations (WeAreTech, 6 May 2025). Koumra is on the PMICE Phase I national fiber route (Doba-Koumra-Sarh...). Phase I provisional reception acted at Sarh 20 Dec 2025; final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites still pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/technical sites, NOT commercial DC.

name: PMICE Phase I reception site - Sarh fiber-optic technical site (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba line)
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner (Ramadan Saadaddine, Huawei country rep, present at ceremony)
notes: The 'inauguration et reception provisoire' ceremony of PMICE Phase I took place in Sarh (Moyen-Chari) on Saturday 20 Dec 2025, presided by Minister Boukar Michel: the fiber line linking Doba, Sarh, Am Timan, Abeche and Iriba was launched, and Phase I infrastructure (national data center component, 1,200 km fiber backbone, SOTEL GSM/3G/4G site extension) declared functional/conforming per the ministry (Ecofin 22 Dec 2025). Program cost 175.1m EUR (~205.3m USD per Ecofin; ~188.3m USD per Tribune Echos). Provincial governor requested immediate connections for University of Sarh, ENASTIC, ONAMA and judicial services. Per methodology, provisional reception is a strong milestone but official exploitation still gated by ADETIC/ANSICE audit-certification (Feb 2026) and final reception of 200 transmission sites; classified PMICE fiber/transmission infrastructure, NOT commercial DC.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Bongor
notes: ADETIC community multimedia center in Bongor (Mayo-Kebbi Est) visited by Minister Boukar Michel on 2-3 May 2025 during his telecom-infrastructure inspection mission; ADETIC ran a digital-literacy training session in Bongor in Jan 2026. One of six ADETIC multimedia telecentres built/equipped nationwide. Institutional ICT/telecentre facility; no commercial colocation data.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Pala (construction launched)
developer: ADETIC (state agency); construction launched by Ministry of Posts & Digital Economy (Idriss Saleh Bachar)
notes: Local press (NDjamena Hebdo) reports construction of an ADETIC multimedia center at Pala (Mayo-Kebbi Ouest) launched by the Posts & Digital Economy minister, following the same norms as the other ADETIC telecentres. Publication date of the article not captured in sweep; evidence_date is the check date (2026-08-12). Classified planned/under-construction institutional ICT center, NOT a commercial data center. No additional Pala-specific DC evidence found.

name: PMICE National Data Center (N'Djamena)
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications/Government of Chad); delivery contractor Huawei; supervision Gulf/GOLF Consultancy; audit-certification partner TECHSO-GROUP with ADETIC/ANSICE
notes: Chad's sovereign National Data Center in N'Djamena (2020 PMICE plan: 2,000 m2 three-storey building). Status per 2026 sources: building completed and digital equipment installed; 5 Feb 2026 tripartite accord (ADETIC/ANSICE/TECHSO-GROUP) for audit and certification of building/equipment - ADETIC DG calls it 'the last stage before the inauguration'; ANSICE conducted a guided visit; Huawei guided the audit visit (ADETIC 12 Feb 2026 article). PMICE Phase I provisional reception acted at Sarh 20 Dec 2025 covers the DC component per ministry. World Bank P180000 (A) confirms PMICE (EXIMBANK US$180m) builds 1,200 km fiber, a Data Center and its national backup, and 200 mobile sites. Per methodology: not officially operational until an A-grade commissioning/inauguration source appears. Capacity (MW/racks) not published; exact address/arrondissement not published.

name: PMICE micro data centers (100, state institutions, interconnected to National DC)
developer: PMICE / ADETIC / ANSICE / TECHSO-GROUP certification program
notes: The Feb 2026 tripartite accord also targets making operational the 100 micro data centers installed within various state institutions, which will be connected to the National Data Center (N'Djamena Actu 5 Feb 2026); Digital Business Africa (May 2026) reports the micro-DC estate delivered under PMICE awaits final configuration/interconnection to the main DC; WeAreTech reports the 100 micro DCs are under the ANSICE/ADETIC/TECHSO certification initiative. Distributed estate anchored in N'Djamena (many state institutions located in the capital); exact per-institution locations not published - recorded under N'Djamena City as the program anchor. Status: installed, awaiting final configuration/interconnection (construction phase).

name: ADETIC backup site / PMICE national data-center backup
developer: PMICE / ADETIC (backup/DR component of National DC program)
notes: World Bank P180000 project document (A) confirms PMICE scope includes 'a Data Center and its national backup'; ADETIC's 12 Feb 2026 audit article mentions inspection of an 'ADETIC backup site' during the joint TECHSO/ADETIC/ANSICE mission. Location, capacity and role not published (assumed N'Djamena-region); treated as A-grade backup/DR lead, not yet a separate verified full DC.

name: TCHADIX national Internet exchange point (G.I.E.)
developer: TCHADIX G.I.E. under ADETIC impulse; ADETIC DG Adoum Djimet Saboun is Board president
notes: TCHADIX is Chad's national Internet exchange point formed as a G.I.E. under ADETIC's impulse; ordinary general assembly held 20 May 2026 (nearly one year after creation) to consolidate the IXP's mission of local traffic exchange among ISPs/operators and reduce international dependency (Alwihda, B). World Bank P180000 (A, 2023) records implementation of an Internet Exchange Point (IXP) at ADETIC, consistent with ADETIC-housed IXP. Physical hosting equipment facility/location and PeeringDB/PCH listing not yet published - open item per methodology. Recorded under N'Djamena (likely location); IXP/network infrastructure, not a commercial DC.

name: Tigo/Millicom modular communications & colocation data center (now Moov Africa Chad lineage)
developer: Flexenclosure (builder); commissioned for Millicom subsidiary Tigo Chad; lineage now Moov Africa Chad / Maroc Telecom
notes: DCD reports Chad's first data center built by Swedish prefab specialist Flexenclosure for Millicom subsidiary Tigo in N'Djamena: 374 m2 communications and colocation center, USD 6m, built in Sweden and shipped to N'Djamena; Flexenclosure press release 30 May 2016 confirms delivery of Chad's first modern data center for Millicom (Tigo). Methodology records 400 kW IT load (B-grade known lead). Tigo Chad sold to Maroc Telecom (2019), rebranded Moov Africa Chad (2021); current operation of the facility under Moov Africa Chad and any public colocation offering remain unverified - open item per methodology.

name: SOTEL core network modernization (PMICE)
developer: SOTEL/Salam (state incumbent) under PMICE; Huawei delivery partner
notes: PMICE includes modernization of SOTEL: 200 GSM/3G/4G sites, core network, subscriber capacity expansion 300,000 to 1,000,000 (2020 plan); Phase I extension of SOTEL wireless network included in the 20 Dec 2025 provisional reception (Ecofin). Government ordered operators Airtel and Moov Africa to connect to the national fiber backbone (1,275 km deployed under PMICE) within a week (27 Aug 2025 ultimatum, Ecofin Agency) due to poor service quality. Classified telco core/network infrastructure under PMICE; not commercial colocation.

name: PMICE national fiber backbone (1,200-1,275 km + N'Djamena GPON)
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: PMICE Phase I national fiber backbone: 1,200 km route (Doba-Koumra-Sarh-Kyabe-Am Timan-Abeche-Am Zoer-Guereda-Iriba) plus 50 km GPON access in N'Djamena per 2020 plan; Ecofin Agency (Aug 2025) reports 1,275 km deployed under PMICE; World Bank P180000 (A) confirms EXIMBANK-financed fiber program. Fiber line provisionally inaugurated at Sarh 20 Dec 2025; operators ordered to interconnect. Recorded under N'Djamena City as the network anchor; backbone spans multiple provinces (route endpoints recorded separately per province). Classified telecom fiber infrastructure, not a DC.

name: Airtel Chad and Moov Africa Chad mobile core / switching rooms (N'Djamena)
developer: Airtel Chad; Moov Africa Chad (Maroc Telecom group)
notes: Per methodology, Airtel and Moov (ex-Tigo) operate mobile core/switching and NOC rooms in N'Djamena but are counted as telco infrastructure, not commercial colocation, unless a named facility is disclosed. Aug 2025 Ecofin Agency directive (B) confirms both operators were ordered to connect to the national fiber backbone. No public facility-level data (address/capacity) found in this sweep - C-grade lead.

name: ARCEP-licensed ISP hosting/server rooms (N'Djamena)
developer: ARCEP-authorized ISPs (Albidey Net, Global Technologies, IlNet, Tchad Broadband, Manano Telecom, Infotel-N'Djamena, Amanet, etc.)
notes: ARCEP ISP list defines the candidate N'Djamena server-room/hosting universe; hosting pages typically prove service rather than a physical facility. No verified in-country physical hosting facility with disclosed location found in this sweep (e.g., TIC Tchad states hosting runs on cloud servers across worldwide data centers - negative evidence of local colo scarcity). C-grade lead only, per methodology: licenses are not facility records.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center / antenna Abeche
developer: ADETIC (state agency); PATN (World Bank digital transformation project) partner for local mechanisms
notes: ADETIC operates an active antenna/multimedia center in Abeche (Ouaddai): digital-inclusion training series ('Vacance Numerique 2026') organized Dec 2025 (Dari-Infos, B; center head Mahamat Abdallah Samil), and PATN installed its complaints-management committee at ADETIC Abeche in June 2026 (govserv, B). One of six ADETIC multimedia telecentres built/equipped nationwide. Institutional ICT/telecentre facility; NOT a commercial data center.

name: PMICE fiber endpoint - Abeche transmission site
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: Abeche is an eastern endpoint of the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh on 20 Dec 2025 (reception provisoire, Huawei present). PMICE 2020 route plan includes Abeche (Doba-Koumra-Sarh-Kyabe-Am Timan-Abeche-Am Zoer-Guereda-Iriba). Final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/fiber site, NOT commercial DC.

name: PMICE fiber endpoint - Am Timan transmission site
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: Am Timan (Salamat) is on the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh 20 Dec 2025, and on the 2020 PMICE route plan. No dedicated DC or named technical-site facility beyond the route/transmission evidence found in this sweep. Classified PMICE transmission/fiber site, NOT commercial DC.

name: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center Biltine
notes: ADETIC multimedia telecentre at Biltine (Wadi Fira) is one of six ADETIC community multimedia centers built and equipped nationwide (Mongo, Abeche, Bongor, Biltine, Amdjarass, Doba) per Alwihda (2019) and Tchadinfos. Institutional ICT/telecentre facility; NOT a commercial data center.

name: PMICE fiber endpoint - Iriba transmission site (Wadi Fira)
developer: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: Iriba (Wadi Fira) is the eastern endpoint of the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh 20 Dec 2025; the 2020 PMICE route plan also includes Am Zoer, Guereda and Iriba in Wadi Fira. Final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/fiber site, NOT commercial DC.
